baselineCalibrationCorrection.diagnosis: The exact original body/status was not recorded. Failure was strict fixture completion with 512 output tokens used; three exact-request diagnostic calls returned the correct marker and confirmed thinkingBudget=0/maxOutputTokens=512. Sampling was unspecified. Do not infer a particular generated body or proven internal provider cause.
baselineCalibrationCorrection.fix: Explicit zero temperature where registry permits, actual sampling metadata and payload-free response status/length/hash; strict predicate/cap and disabled test/empty-response retries unchanged.

calibration.transportRetryPolicy: Existing provider/connector policy; this probe does not claim a single HTTP attempt.
